data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mauhub means 'a welcome guest'. It is derived from the root word 'haba' which means 'to welcome'. This name holds a spiritual significance in Islam as it represents the warm welcome and hospitality extended to guests and visitors. The name Mauhub carries the meaning “A welcome guest” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mauhub usually hope their child will grow to embody a welcome guest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
